post.description:
You have a business_entity_id from search_entities or get_registered_agent and need the full registration record, filing history or document links.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。

business_entity_id.description: The registry's internal entity id (digits), or a pasted BusinessEntityDetail.aspx URL carrying ID=.

filings_page.description:
1-based page of the filed documents grid (10 rows per page, newest first). The general information and address grids are the same on every page.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 1.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The registry's Business Entity Details page for one internal entity id (BusinessEntityDetail.aspx?ID=...): general information (name(s), type, charter number, domesticity, home state, status, date formed, duration, registered agent with address and id, any further labelled fields the page shows), one page of the filed documents grid including registration reports (10 rows per page on the site: filing id, action, type, name, dates and the public document link of each filing; later pages through filings_page), the principal office address grid, and the officers, owners, stock and contacts grids when the registry renders rows for them. Fails with not_found when the registry answers the id with its search form instead of a details page.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `business_entity_id` | string |  |
| `charter_number` | string |  |
| `contacts` | object[] |  |
| `date_formed` | string | As displayed (M/D/YYYY). |
| `date_formed_iso` | string |  |
| `domesticity` | string |  |
| `duration` | string |  |
| `entity_type` | string |  |
| `filings` | object[] |  |
| `filings_as_of` | string | The 'Filed Documents as of ...' stamp as displayed (US Central time). |
| `filings_page` | number | Filed documents page returned (1 when the grid has no pager). |
| `filings_page_count` | number | Pages of filed documents as the grid's pager states it (0 when the grid is empty, 1 when it has rows but no pager). |
| `filings_total` | number | Total filed documents as the pager states it; null when the grid shows no pager (then `filings` is the whole grid). |
| `home_state` | string |  |
| `name` | string | First line of the page's Name(s) field. |

| `registered_agent` | object |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `status` | string |  |
| `stock` | object[] |  |

200.description:
The registry's Registered Agent Details page (RegisteredAgentDetail.aspx?RegAgentID=...): the agent's name, address and status, and one page (20 rows) of the grid of entities the agent represents, with each entity's id, charter number, type, status and creation date. post.description:
You know (part of) a Missouri business name or a charter number (LC1041362, LP0013885, FL001415560, 00123456 ...) and need the entity's internal id, status, type or registered agent, or want to page through all matches.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.0005 USD（不是固定价格）。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

active_only.description: business_name only: tick the site's 'Only Active Corporations' box.

match.description:
Name search method (business_name only): Starting With (default), All Words, Any Word or Exact Match. The site advises including corporate designations (Inc., LLC) and punctuation only for exact matches.

Provider reference: allowed values ["starts_with", "all_words", "any_word", "exact"]; default "starts_with".

page.description:
1-based results page (20 rows per page). Pages after the first are reached by replaying the search and paging the grid; each page costs its own requests.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 100; default 1.

query.description: Business name text (search_type business_name) or a charter number (search_type charter_number).

search_type.description:
Which registry search to run: the Business Name search (default) or the Charter No. search.

Provider reference: allowed values ["business_name", "charter_number"]; default "business_name".

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Search the Missouri business entity registry (BESearch.aspx) by business name (starting with, all words, any word or exact match, optionally active corporations only) or by charter number. Returns one page of the registry's results grid (20 rows per page) exactly as the site lists it: primary-name rows carry the charter number, entity type, status, creation date and registered agent; previous-name rows (is_primary_name false) carry only the former name and the entity id they belong to. A search with no hits is a successful empty page (total 0).

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `count` | number | Rows on this page. |
| `items_from` | number | 1-based index of the first row on this page as the pager states it; null when the pager is absent (no records). |
| `items_to` | number |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page` | number | Page returned, as the grid's pager states it. |
| `page_count` | number | Pages available for this search as the pager states it (0 when there are no records). |
| `query` | object |  |
| `results` | object[] |  |
| `source_url` | string |  |
| `total` | number | Total rows the pager reports for this search (primary and previous-name rows together). |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
